cohort: Women who underwent cesarean delivery at a tertiary hospital in Changsha, Hunan, China, from January 1, 2007, to December 31, 2016
finding: The incidence of placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) disorders increased significantly alongside a rise in elective repeat cesarean delivery within the context of the universal two-child policy in China.
mod_finding: Previous cesarean delivery greatly increased the likelihood of PAS disorders.
